title.narrative: Water Supply, Sanitation and Drainage Project

description.narrative: Zambia - Water Supply, Sanitation and Drainage Project: This activity supports infrastructure managed by the Lusaka Water and Sewerage Company and Lusaka City Council. A key focus is rehabilitation of Lusaka's water supply network, including reducing non-revenue water. It also will expand portions of the city's water supply network; rehabilitate and expand portions of the sewer networks; and improve drainage infrastructure.

title.narrative: The number of households reached with messages on hygiene and sanitary best practices

description.narrative: Cumulative Output of The data for this indicator is from the IECSMI final report LWSC 20181105. However, due to the way the door to door campaign was implemented the data for this indicator cannot be disaggregated by Female-headed households and Male-headed houses. The consultant�s implementation of the door to door campaign also led to the possibility of some double counting in this indicator, because community mobilizers visited plots/households more than one time over the course of the 2 years, as construction continued. Due to this known issue, MCC M&E recommends that exact numbers for this indicator not be reported out for any external publication, however there is high confidence that the campaign reached saturation for target beneficiaries.

title.narrative: Total length of sewer pipes constructed (Tertiary)

description.narrative: Cumulative Output of This indicator tracks the tertiary sewers that directly serve households in the peri-urban Mtendere neighborhood. The underperforming contractor reported that work on 75 km of pipe had been completed, but there are early indications that some portion may need to be redone. Therefore, no work from Mtendere is being counted towards the completion of the target. The Government of Zambia is continuing this work, and this indicator is being tracked post-compact.
